Introduction
The Department of Health Technology and Informatics offers opportunities for research studies leading to Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) and Master of Philosophy (MPhil) degrees in the following focused research areas.
Diabetes and Metabolic Diseases: From Pathogenesis to Therapy
Immunometabolism
Intelligent Medical Imaging in Disease Diagnosis and Prognosis Assessment
Microbiology and Antimicrobial Resistance in One Health
Neuroimaging and Neuropathology
Precision Diagnostics and Therapeutics

Supporting Documents
Academic Referee's Report
Compulsory - Nominate two academics to complete online academic referee's reports.
The nominated referees should be familiar with your academic performance and achievements. Proposed supervisor(s) from the PolyU, proposed supervisor(s) from the partner institution (if any), and persons from non-academic background are not considered as appropriate academic referees.
Please note that the email addresses of the nominated referees are required to be under a university or an organisation.
Curriculum Vitae
Compulsory
Research Proposal
Compulsory
A standard form must be used for the submission of a research proposal. Please click here to download the form.
Please indicate your proposed Chief Supervisor in your research proposal.
Transcript / Certificate
Compulsory
Official certificates/transcripts of your undergraduate and postgraduate studies indicating the credit unit of each subject you have completed, your award classification and/ or your ranking in the graduation class are required.
The explanatory notes on the grading system and classifications of your awards are required.
Others
Compulsory if you hold an MPhil degree or equivalent
Official documents showing a research postgraduate degree with a dissertation as an award requirement are required.
